meta.updated: 2026-09-27: added the extra type sizes and layout values the page designs and the site build use

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Brand. Deep aubergine: header, hero, night sections, button fills, and all text on paper and dandelion (17.1:1 on paper, 11.9:1 on dandelion). Framer token 6f8bbe9a.

tokens.name: dandelion
tokens.usage: Brand. Headlines, button labels and outlines on night (11.9:1), the seed-band ground and the logo on night. Never text on paper (1.4:1). Framer token 1165837e.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand. Warm off-white ground for content sections; text on night (17.1:1). Framer token 217dc750.

tokens.name: wheat
tokens.usage: Seen on the live site only as the lower stop of the hero photo fade (night to wheat). Use for photo overlays, not as a flat UI colour.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: Addition. Cards and inputs set on a night section; dandelion text on it holds 10.0:1, paper 14.6:1.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Addition. Cards and alternate bands on paper; night text on it holds 15.4:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Addition. Secondary text (captions, meta, helper text) on paper (7.0:1) and paper-sunk (6.3:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted-on-night
tokens.usage: Addition. Secondary text on night (10.2:1) and night-raised (8.6:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Addition. Decorative dividers on paper only; never a control border (controls use night at border-strong).

tokens.name: hairline-on-night
tokens.usage: Addition. Decorative dividers on night only.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Addition. Form error text and error field border on paper (7.0:1). Always paired with a written message, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Addition. Form success text on paper (6.0:1), with a check icon and words. Keep it small: never beside dandelion, since green next to yellow reads as generic charity.

tokens.name: focus-on-paper
tokens.usage: Focus ring on paper and dandelion grounds: 2px solid, offset 3px.

tokens.name: focus-on-night
tokens.usage: Focus ring on night grounds: 2px solid, offset 3px.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Addition. Desktop hero only (at 1024px and up); set in capitals. Steps down to display below 1024px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Live site section headlines (Unbounded 900 40/36), always in capitals. Dandelion on night, night on paper.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Live site kicker above a display headline, in capitals, same colour as the headline or paper on night.

styles.name: detail
styles.usage: Live site light Unbounded for reference details such as bank and registration lines.

styles.name: eyebrow-lg
styles.usage: Route-card titles on Get involved. Capitals.

styles.name: eyebrow-sm
styles.usage: Eyebrows under 600px, card kickers, footer headings. Capitals.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Status tags on cards: dandelion on night. Capitals.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Live site Geist 700 32: card and page titles in sentence case.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Live site Geist 700 24: dates, place names, subheads.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Card titles (past plantings, mobile planting card).

styles.name: subtitle-sm
styles.usage: Subtitles under 600px: site and programme names.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Bring gloves if you've got them.
styles.usage: Live site short body lines (Geist 700 18/19.8). One to three lines only; use body for anything longer. Line height 100%.

styles.name: lead-strong
styles.usage: Live site emphasis inside lead (Geist 900). Line height 100%.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A food forest grows in layers, so every bit of sun and soil is doing something.
styles.usage: Addition. Long-form reading (journal, about, site stories), which the live site does not have yet. 60-72 characters a line. Line height 100%.

styles.name: small-lg
styles.sample: Layered plantings of fruit trees, shrubs and ground cover.
styles.usage: Card descriptions, footer links, mobile body. Line height 100%.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: We'll only use your email to confirm your spot.
styles.usage: Addition. Captions, helper text, form hints, footer small print. Line height 100%.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between stacked buttons' inner lines, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to input; between the two stacked live-site buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; paragraph gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button padding top and bottom (live site 20px).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button padding left and right (live site 30px).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Tablet and desktop page gutter (live site left edge at 32px).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Headline block to body; card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, inputs, images. The brand is square-cornered; there are no rounded variants.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Button outlines, input borders, card outlines.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers (hairline, hairline-on-night).

tokens.name: measure-content
tokens.usage: Addition. Max width of the content column; the header and bands stay full-bleed.

tokens.name: measure-text
tokens.usage: Addition. Max width of long-form text (body).

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its 2px focus ring.

tokens.name: logo-width
tokens.usage: Logo width in the header and footer (live site).

tokens.name: logo-height
tokens.usage: Logo height at logo-width.

tokens.name: logo-width-sm
tokens.usage: Logo width under 600px.

tokens.name: logo-height-sm
tokens.usage: Logo height at logo-width-sm.

tokens.name: seedband-height
tokens.usage: Seed band height (live site); keep it when the Rive story replaces the seed.

tokens.name: seedband-height-sm
tokens.usage: Seed band height under 600px.

tokens.name: seed-size
tokens.usage: Large seed on the seed band.

tokens.name: seed-size-sm
tokens.usage: Large seed under 600px.

tokens.name: seed-pattern-size
tokens.usage: Repeat size of the paper seed pattern tile.

tokens.name: seed-pattern-size-sm
tokens.usage: Pattern repeat under 600px.

tokens.name: card-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of a planting card.

tokens.name: field-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of form fields.
